utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll ask around for a couple tool-sorters and see who can cover the sign-in table. Once the time’s set, Faye can help work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — I’ll spread the word and ask around for tools and supplies. I’ll also check with Quinn on the exact time and parking, then let Pia know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Sam — I’ll keep asking around for tool-sorters and a sign-in helper. Once Quinn confirms the time, I’ll pass it along so Faye can plan around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, we still need cleaning supplies and sturdy blankets for the repair drive. I’m glad Sam and Quinn are helping spread the word, and Eli can sort the fixable things.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands anyway, so I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything helpful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that. If you spot cleaning supplies or sturdy blankets, that’d really help us out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Faye — if you can help line things up with the school schedule, that’d really help. I’ll pass along the latest repair drive updates too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out at school pickup and pass along anything I hear. That’ll help me line things up around the school schedule too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything new about the repair drive. Rosa’s sorting the sign-up list, so I’ll pass along any updates on that too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — once you’ve got it sorted, let me know what you need and I’ll help. Sunday at the community center still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll sort it out and check in with you and Vik. Once I know what I need, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, Dane. Just let me know once it’s sorted, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll sort the fixable items, and it helps if we keep one drop-off spot and a set pickup time. That way everything stays orderly for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds orderly, but are you sure we still need cleaning supplies and sturdy blankets?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I think so — they’ll help keep the items safe and tidy until pickup. If you like, we can make a simple list and keep the drive to one spot and one time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend out my hammer, screwdriver set, and tape measure for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I can swing by and help with the loose fence panels, the hallway light, and a couple porch steps. I can also grab a few tools and help at the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a huge help, Bo — swing by anytime and grab the hammer, screwdriver set, and tape measure from me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s Sunday now, so I’ll check back with Cleo later and keep an ear out for Noah. I’ll let Gus know what tools would help most and tell Vik what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’m heading to Maple Street and the corner apartments to spread the word about the repair drive. If you and Noah compare notes, just pass anything new my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I will. If I hear from Noah, I’ll pass along anything new right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and sturdy work gloves, and I can help sort the tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Leo — I’ve got the location updates covered, and Tess is checking with Kira for the exact list. I’ll pass along anything else we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just let me know if anything else is needed, and I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, but I still need the timing nailed down and a clear parking plan. If we keep it organized, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — it’s on Sunday later at the community center. I’m sorting the sign-up list now, and I’ll make sure the parking plan is clear too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, Sunday later at the community center works for me. If you send me the exact time and where to park, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — if you make it later, we can compare notes on what’s still left. Rey’ll keep an ear out and let us know what’s needed too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, if I make it later I’ll compare notes with you. I might miss a few updates, but I’ll try to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — just swing by if you can, and we’ll go over what’s left. If you get pulled away, Rey’s keeping an ear out and will pass along any updates.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll wait for Hana’s update on the exact time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive supplies and check what’s running low for us.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect—let me know if anything is running low, and I’ll wait for Hana’s update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on Mara’s repair drive details before I say more. Once I have them, I’ll check the list carefully and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep my ears open at pickup and around the neighborhood, and I’ll pass along whatever’s still needed for the repair drive as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — that helps. I’ll wait for Mara’s details and then review everything carefully before I respond.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Leo’s got the tools ready, so we’re set there. Eli can sort the fixable items, and Gus can bring any extra tools if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring the hammer, screwdrivers, and sturdy work gloves, and I can help sort the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, then we’ve got the tools covered and Eli can still sort the fixable items. We’re set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — we still need cleaning supplies and sturdy blankets for the repair drive. Sam’s spreading the word, and Eli’s sorting the fixable things, if I’m remembering that right.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, I’ve got it mixed up sometimes, but that sounds about right. I’ll keep my ears open too and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — that’d be a big help. If you hear anything, just compare notes with me and I’ll try to keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll come by and help with the loose fence panels, the hallway light, and those porch steps. I can also grab a few tools and help at the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Bo — thank you. I’ll ask around for the tools and supplies, and I’ll spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll swing by and help with the fence, light, and porch steps. Thanks for handling the tools and spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good — once the repair drive time is set, Jules can ask around for a couple tool-sorters and someone to cover the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — once you confirm the time and needs, I’ll ask around for tool-sorters and someone to handle the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — I’ll confirm the time and what’s still needed, then let you know. Dane can check in on the remaining needs, and Cleo can see what supplies are running low.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Gus said he’d check with you about which tools would help most, and I heard Rosa’s sorting the sign-up list to match folks with the right repairs. Uli’s helping too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds right for Sunday. I’ll check back with Cleo later and let Gus know what tools would help most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll pass that along. Just let me know what Gus should bring, and I’ll keep an eye out for Rosa’s list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by late, but I can help with the repair drive. Sam and Quinn have the word covered, and Cleo can keep an eye on supplies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on the location updates for the repair drive, and Tess can grab the exact list from Kira if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s great, Opal — thank you. If Tess can grab the list from Kira, we’ll be in good shape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive supplies until Dane gets here. If anything’s running low, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll sort the fixable items, check the usual spots, and then bring Opal a clear update.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Eli—if you find we’re short on anything, let me know and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I can lend a hammer, a screwdriver set, and a tape measure for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’s a big help. Could you also ask around for a couple tool-sorters and someone to cover the sign-in table?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can ask around for both, Mara. I’ll see who can help with the tool sorting and the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good — once Dane has it sorted, let me know what you need and I’ll help. Sunday at the community center still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll let you know once Dane has it sorted. Sunday at the community center is still the plan, and I’ll keep your help in mind.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll be ready once Dane has it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana’s checking the exact time and whether I need to bring anything, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please—if we can lock in one pickup time and one clear drop-off point, I’m happy to help. I just want to make sure the parking stays manageable too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll wait for Hana’s exact time and bring whatever she says is needed. One pickup spot and one drop-off point works for me too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep my ears open at pickup and around the neighborhood, and I’ll pass along the exact list of what’s still needed for the repair drive as soon as I get it from Kira.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So we still need cleaning supplies and sturdy blankets, right? And Pia and Bo are already helping keep it organized?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that’s right — cleaning supplies and sturdy blankets are still needed, and Pia and Bo are helping keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, once the time’s set I can loop in the school schedule with Faye. Mina’s checking on timing and supplies, and Gus and Leo already have the tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I can work around the school schedule once you lock in the time. It’s great that Mina’s on timing and supplies, and that Leo already has the tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Faye — I’ll wait for Mina to confirm the time and what she needs to bring, then I’ll circle back so we can line it up with the school schedule.
